messages.author: GMDS
messages.text:
Well it's been a while since we have complained about people (not) playing games, so its time to name and shame.

Rom was dropped 8/14 or 35 days ago. Site says we have 35.5 days left, so we ALL should be at the 50% range. That means all players should be in the 28 GP range.

I'm willing to give folks some wiggle room, but there is no reason all GMs shouldn't be at 20-22 GP which is about 40%

4 GMs - Vick, matty, jer, NJ killer all under 10 GP or less than 20%

8 gms - sega, Lloyd, chalk,  auto, Maryland mike, Moses, Vance, and LHX all between 12-18 GP, which is 20-33% of GP.

It can't be stressed enough that not playing your games affects others, and especially when draft picks have been traded. We all are busy, but if your schedule doesn't allow you to play 4 games a week or about 45 minutes a week, this is a larger issue.

We all laugh at the guy who plows through 30 games in 2 days, but it's  not a viable strategy,  and moreso is not respectful of the other players (I.e. I've had 9 weeks, but hey I'm here in the last week so everyone make sure your available to fit my schedule).

Anyways let the consternation begin

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: 🚨 TickleBlurb: Tickleweb developers have added some small tweaks to the scores bar at the top of TickleWeb.  You can now scroll left and right if you're using a smaller ghetto screen....It's also always bugged them that the L10 and streaks showed the "current" values instead of the actual values after each game, so that has been fixed (with G1 and G2 now displayed)...On a desktop, the "flip" is gone and a hover is shown since we've now fixed it to handle ties and (stupid) OTLs.  The hover window gives it a little more real estate, if you catch my drift.  On mobile, it's still a flip and the streak was removed because there's just not enough room.   Happy Thursday....

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: FYI - if you added the page to your homescreen, it does truly function as an app so you'll have to force close it and relaunch to get the latest and greatest 🚬

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Additionally, as if yinz care, the navigation tabs have been slightly condensed to support the ghetto screens as well
